sentences.en: He cited, during his speech, Kant and Heidegger among others.
sentences.zh: 他在演讲中引用了康德和海德格尔等人的观点。

sentences.en: Basque is a commonly cited example of a language isolate.
sentences.zh: 巴斯克语常被引为孤立语言的例子。

sentences.en: Someone cited his junk theory in an actual medical journal.
sentences.zh: 有人在实际的医学期刊上引用了他的垃圾理论。

senses.zh: 引用，援引；引证，引以为例；传唤，传讯；嘉奖，表彰
